cache_bound_source_proof.claim: The scheduler change cannot move cache identity, because independent_daily.py is not one of the sources bound into monthly_sumo.py's source_digest, which is carried in the backend provenance that the unit cache key hashes.

cache_state.cache_manifest_note: Per-file sha256 manifest of every cache entry, frozen at /tmp/gs-provenance/cache_manifest_prestop.txt. The cache root is shared across searches, so the raw file count is NOT this campaign's completed-unit count.

measured_bottleneck.interpretation: worker_seconds/active_elapsed_s = 0.905 means ONE unit worker was busy ~90% of wall time. Against 8 configured slots that is ~11.3% utilization. The width is configured but unreachable because batching is parent-local: a 5-day parent supplies at most 5 units and, measured here, 3229 hits vs 851 misses means ~3.96 of every 5 parent units are already cached, leaving ~1.04 genuinely new units per parent - not enough to fill even two slots, let alone eight.
measured_bottleneck.sampling_note: 20 samples at 3 s intervals over the live process group 68201, immediately before the stop. Every sample showed exactly one isolated daily worker; SUMO was absent in one sample during worker turnaround.

measured_unit_cost.basis: worker_seconds / units_simulated over the frozen campaign

post_stop_verification.leftover_worker_tempdir_note: One /var/folders worker temp directory remains, dated 2026-08-21. It predates this campaign (started 2026-08-26) and was not created by the stop; left untouched.

resume_probe.method: Reconstructed each unit's cache key as sha256(canonical({unit: identity, unit_backend_digest: ...})) from ledgers/units.ndjson and artifacts/simulation-backend.json, then validated schema, unit identity, backend digest and content_key of every entry found.

post_stop_verification.workspace_progress_pointer_note: The shutdown path reset the manifest progress pointer to completed=0/total=null. That is a DISPLAY counter, not the resume state: resumability is carried by the content-addressed cache, which a resumed run re-verifies per unit against the frozen unit ledger and backend map.

purpose: Frozen pre-stop state of campaign ui-monthly-13lhsoy-5d, recorded immediately before a user-approved controlled stop for performance optimization. Grounds the measured parent-local batching bottleneck.
